name: Mt. Pilatus Golden Round Trip
overview: The Mt. Pilatus Golden Round Trip is one of Switzerland's most spectacular excursions, combining boat, cogwheel train, and cable car. This circular journey offers breathtaking alpine views and access to the legendary 'Dragon Mountain' at 2,132 meters.
history: Mount Pilatus has been shrouded in legends for centuries, once believed to be haunted by the ghost of Pontius Pilate. The cogwheel railway, opened in 1889, is the world's steepest at a 48% gradient. The aerial cableways opened in 1956.
highlights: Dragon's Path adventure trail with ropes course
Legend of Pontius Pilate and dragon folklore
tips: Allow full day for complete round trip. Weather can change rapidly - bring layers. Book early during peak season. May-October optimal for all transport modes. Alternative routes available if weather affects aerial cableways.
